task: Implement schedule_task for the data pipeline without inheriting job queue semantics.

candidate_memories.content: Data pipeline schedule_task should enqueue a batch processing job at a user-specified offset.
Pipeline scheduling uses cron-style offset expressions; jobs are idempotent within a window.
Pipeline task IDs are derived from content hash; duplicate schedules are silently deduplicated.
When schedule_task appears in multiple services, verify the scheduling model before implementing.
Job queue: schedule_task enqueues a persistent job with retry semantics and a priority weight.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: job queue scheduling semantics conflict with the pipeline's offset model

candidate_memories.content: Old platform note says scheduling should be unified across pipelines and job queues eventually.
